posts.title: Bored and Tired
posts.content:
I've been so sleepy lately. I just don't feel the need to do anything. I miss my dog. 

I guess I never talked about it on my blog but she passed away a week and a half ago. Really sudden decision we had to make cause she had Pyometra and we just could not take care of her. I have no money, I am starting school soon, I am working next month, I just... I don't know.

The decision to spay her was up to me when I was 10 years old. The only way it was described to me was to choose to not let my dog have puppies or let her have puppies. If I had known not spaying = pyometra, I would've just done it. But I didn't know any better. This is kinda what makes me think my mom was the one who killed her. She didn't care to take care of her or do any research at all and just let me take the fall for the decision. I felt so alone.

I don't regret the decision that I made. I just wish I had the option to make another one. But I didn't. My baby isn't suffering anymore. That's all I could hope for...
